events.shugo.favHint: Star a minigame to spot its rounds
events.shugo.g.upupup: Platform race to the highest point.
events.shugo.g.track: Race other players on a multicolored course.
events.shugo.g.goldrin: Search on foot and in flight for chests that spawn at random.
events.shugo.g.lugi: Hide and seek: Lugis collect bubbles while Shugos hunt them among the NPC Lugis.
events.shugo.g.odyle: Fly around collecting Odyle of different values, with longer flight time and boosts.
events.shugo.g.defend: Co-op PvE: protect the Shugo merchants from waves of enemies.
events.shugo.g.tile: Memory game: grab XP bubbles, then stand on a safe tile before time runs out.
events.shugo.g.wraith: Tag: whoever is caught becomes a wraith until they catch someone else.
events.shugo.g.jump: As a Shugo, dodge the lasers moving on the ground and grab bubbles.
events.shugo.shopHint: Tick what you want to buy with Centuryroot Tokens.
events.shugo.keysText: After a round, a better placement unlocks more reward cards: each card uses a key, so save them for your best finishes.
events.shugo.keysSub: Subscribers: 4 keys a day, up to 28
events.shugo.keysFree: Free: 1 key a day, up to 7
events.shugo.source: Rounds every hour at :15 and :45, 10 minutes each, one minigame drawn from the pool. Minigames, keys and prices come from the KR/TW servers (Season 1) and may change at the global launch.
events.rift.runningHint: The portal has closed: whoever is inside plays until the end of the hour.
events.rift.f.portal: The portal stays open 5 minutes, the event lasts 1 hour
events.rift.f.warMode: War Mode: choose whether to take part in PvP (70 minutes to switch again)
events.rift.f.activities: PvP, Sealed Dungeons, quests and Abyss Points
events.rift.source: Times in your PC's local time. Schedule from the KR/TW servers (from 02:00 server time, every 3 hours); the {region} server clock is provisional until NC confirms it at the global launch.
